div.p: Used to specify a rendering style for a string. It is recommended that the value conforms to W3C CSS.
The style attribute may occur on span to indicate rendering instructions. It is highly recommended that the value of style be expressed as a W3C CSS style to facilitate interoperability.
Additionally, style may occur on title.

div.egXML: During 1918, Robert Carlton Brown (1886-1959) traveled extensively in Mexico and Central America, writing for the U.S. Committee of Public Information in Santiago de Chile. In 1919, he moved with his wife, Rose Brown, to Rio de Janeiro, where they founded Brazilian American, a weekly magazine that ran until 1929. With Brown's mother, Cora, the Browns also established magazines in Mexico City and London: Mexican American (1924-1929) and British American (1926-1929).
